'''The Nabooian Citizen''' was a news service on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It published pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] news that could be read for free at many Nabooian [[newsnet terminal]]s.
